details.description: A list of messages that carry the error details. There is a common set of message types for APIs to use.

additionalProperties.description: Properties of the object. Contains field @type with type URL.

UserIdInfo.description: Additional information when `USER_ID` is one of the `upload_key_types`.

dataSourceType.description: Optional. Immutable. Source of the upload data.
enumDescriptions: The uploaded data is first-party data.
The uploaded data is from a third-party credit bureau.
The uploaded data is from a third-party voter file.
The uploaded data is third party partner data.

PartnerCustomerAccount.description: Represents a customer account in the partner's system.

accountId.description: Required. The identifier of the customer account in the partner's ID space.

accountName.description: Optional. The name of the account.

accountType.description: Optional. The type of the account. Can be used to distinguish between advertiser accounts and business level accounts, for example.

UserProperty.description: A bucket of any additional [user properties](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/protocol/ga4/user-properties) for the user associated with this event.

propertyName.description: Required. The name of the user property to use.

value.description: Required. The string representation of the value of the user property to use.

userListGlobalLicenses.description: The licenses for the given user list in the request.

nextPageToken.description: A token, which can be sent as `page_token` to retrieve the next page. If this field is omitted, there are no subsequent pages.

DataTypeCount.description: The count for a specific data type.

enumDescriptions: The data is an email address.
The data is a phone number.
The data is a physical address.
The data is an IP address.

count.description: The count for this data type.

PpidData.description: Publisher provided identifiers data holding the ppids. At least one ppid is required. This feature is only available to data partners.

ppids.description: Required. The list of publisher provided identifiers for a user.

nextPageToken.description: A token, which can be sent as `page_token` to retrieve the next page. If this field is omitted, there are no subsequent pages.

partnerLinks.description: The partner links for the given account.

Destination.description: The Google product you're sending data to. For example, a Google Ads account.

operatingAccount.description: Required. The account to send the data to or remove the data from.

linkedAccount.description: Optional. An account that the calling user's `login_account` has access to, through an established account link. For example, a data partner's `login_account` might have access to a client's `linked_account`. The partner might use this field to send data from the `linked_account` to another `operating_account`.

loginAccount.description: Optional. The account used to make this API call. To add or remove data from the `operating_account`, this `login_account` must have write access to the `operating_account`. For example, a manager account of the `operating_account`, or an account with an established link to the `operating_account`.

reference.description: Optional. ID for this `Destination` resource, unique within the request. Use to reference this `Destination` in the IngestEventsRequest and IngestAudienceMembersRequest.

productDestinationId.description: Required. The object within the product account to ingest into. For example, a Google Ads audience ID, a Display & Video 360 audience ID or a Google Ads conversion action ID.

RemovePpidDataStatus.description: The status of the ppid data removal from the destination.

recordCount.description: The total count of audience members sent in the removal request. Includes all audience members in the request, regardless of whether they were successfully removed or not.

ppidCount.description: The total count of ppids sent in the removal request. Includes all ppids in the request, regardless of whether they were successfully removed or not.

Event.description: An event representing a user interaction with an advertiser's website or app.

eventDeviceInfo.description: Optional. Information gathered about the device being used (if any) when the event happened.

conversionValue.description: Optional. The conversion value associated with the event, for value-based conversions.

lastUpdatedTimestamp.description: Optional. The last time the event was updated.

conversionCount.description: Optional. The conversion quantity associated with the event, for counting-based conversions.

appInstanceId.description: Optional. A unique identifier for the user instance of an app client for this GA4 app stream.

adIdentifiers.description: Optional. Identifiers and other information used to match the conversion event with other online activity (such as ad clicks).

transactionId.description: Optional. The unique identifier for this event. Required for events sent as an additional data source for tag conversions.

consent.description: Optional. Information about whether the associated user has provided different types of consent.

userProperties.description: Optional. Advertiser-assessed information about the user at the time that the event happened.

eventTimestamp.description: Required. The time the event occurred.

userData.description: Optional. Pieces of user provided data, representing the user the event is associated with.

cartData.description: Optional. Information about the transaction and items associated with the event.

experimentalFields.description: Optional. A list of key/value pairs for experimental fields that may eventually be promoted to be part of the API.

currency.description: Optional. The currency code associated with all monetary values within this event.

additionalEventParameters.description: Optional. A bucket of any [event parameters](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/protocol/ga4/reference/events) to be included within the event that were not already specified using other structured fields.

eventSource.description: Optional. Signal for where the event happened (web, app, in-store, etc.).
enumDescriptions: Unspecified EventSource. Should never be used.
The event was generated from a web browser.
The event was generated from an app.
The event was generated from an in-store transaction.
The event was generated from a phone call.
The event was generated from a message.
The event was generated from other sources.

destinationReferences.description: Optional. Reference string used to determine the destination. If empty, the event will be sent to all destinations in the request.

eventName.description: Optional. The name of the event. Required for GA4 events.

clientId.description: Optional. A unique identifier for the user instance of a web client for this GA4 web stream.

customVariables.description: Optional. Additional key/value pair information to send to the conversion containers (conversion action or FL activity).

userId.description: Optional. A unique identifier for a user, as defined by the advertiser.

eventLocation.description: Optional. Information gathered about the location of the user when this event occurred.

thirdPartyUserData.description: Optional. The same type of data provided in user_data, but explicitly flagged as being provided as owned by a third-party and not first-party advertiser data.

costType.description: Immutable. The cost type of this pricing. Can be set only in the `create` operation. Can't be updated for an existing license.

maxCostMicros.description: Optional. The maximum CPM a commerce audience can be charged when the MEDIA_SHARE cost type is used. The value is in micro units (10^-6) and in the currency specified by the currency_code field. For example, 2000000 means $2 if `currency_code` is `USD`. This is only relevant when cost_type is MEDIA_SHARE. When cost_type is not MEDIA_SHARE, and this field is set, a MAX_COST_NOT_ALLOWED error will be returned. If not set or set to`0`, there is no cap.

endTime.description: Optional. End time of the pricing.

pricingId.description: Output only. The ID of this pricing.

costMicros.description: Optional. The cost associated with the model, in micro units (10^-6), in the currency specified by the currency_code field. For example, 2000000 means $2 if `currency_code` is `USD`.

startTime.description: Output only. Start time of the pricing.

pricingActive.description: Output only. Whether this pricing is active.

currencyCode.description: Optional. The currency in which cost and max_cost is specified. Must be a three-letter currency code defined in ISO 4217.

buyerApprovalState.description: Output only. The buyer approval state of this pricing. This field is read-only.
enumDescriptions: User list client has not yet accepted the pricing terms set by the user list owner.
User list client has accepted the pricing terms set by the user list owner.
User list client has rejected the pricing terms set by the user list owner.

variable.description: Optional. The name of the custom variable to set. If the variable is not found for the given destination, it will be ignored.

value.description: Optional. The value to store for the custom variable.

destinationReferences.description: Optional. Reference string used to determine which of the Event.destination_references the custom variable should be sent to. If empty, the Event.destination_references will be used.

RemoveAudienceMembersStatus.description: The status of the remove audience members request.

userIdDataRemovalStatus.description: The status of the user id data removal from the destination.

compositeDataRemovalStatus.description: The status of the composite data removal from the destination.

pairDataRemovalStatus.description: The status of the pair data removal from the destination.

ppidDataRemovalStatus.description: The status of the ppid data removal from the destination.

mobileDataRemovalStatus.description: The status of the mobile data removal from the destination.

userDataRemovalStatus.description: The status of the user data removal from the destination.

IpData.description: IP address information for a user. We recommend including observe_start_time and observe_end_time to help improve Customer Match match rates.

ipAddress.description: Required. IP address captured at the time of customer interaction. Accepts standard string formats for both IPv4 and IPv6.

observeStartTime.description: Optional. First recorded interaction time from this IP address in a session.

observeEndTime.description: Optional. Last recorded interaction time from this IP address in a session.

userListId.description: Required. The user list ID for which insights are requested.

baseline.description: Required. Baseline for the insights requested.

PseudonymousIdInfo.description: Additional information when `PSEUDONYMOUS_ID` is one of the `upload_key_types`.

enumDescriptions: The user list has been created as a placeholder. List contents and/or metadata are still being synced. The user list is not ready for use.
The user list is ready for use. Contents and cookies have been synced correctly.
An error has occurred syncing user list contents and/or metadata. The user list cannot be used.
syncStatus.description: Output only. Sync status of the user list.

billableRecordCount.description: Optional. Immutable. The number of billable records (e.g. uploaded or matched).

AdIdentifiers.description: Identifiers and other information used to match the conversion event with other online activity (such as ad clicks).

wbraid.description: Optional. The click identifier for clicks associated with web events and originating from iOS devices starting with iOS14.

dclid.description: Optional. The display click ID associated with this event.

sessionAttributes.description: Optional. Session attributes for event attribution and modeling.

impressionId.description: Optional. The impression ID associated with this event.

mobileDeviceId.description: Optional. The mobile identifier for advertisers. This would be IDFA on iOS, AdID on Android, or other platforms’ identifiers for advertisers.

encryptedUserIds.description: Optional. Any number of encrypted user IDs.

gclid.description: Optional. The Google click ID (gclid) associated with this event.

landingPageDeviceInfo.description: Optional. Information gathered about the device being used (if any) at the time of landing onto the advertiser’s site after interacting with the ad.

gbraid.description: Optional. The click identifier for clicks associated with app events and originating from iOS devices starting with iOS14.

matchId.description: Optional. The match ID field used to join this event with a previous event.

UserIdData.description: User id data holding the user id.

userId.description: Required. A unique identifier for a user, as defined by the advertiser.
